paragraphs: Latest work: Coty's consolidated solution/deck/workbooks and 5:09 motion film were emailed to Saurabh; Indian Bank's revised demo and 3:05 film were emailed to Ganesh, Cc Saurabh. Ganesh then sent six further film revisions and reiterated Saurabh's existing approval; these are the first continuation item in the handoff. Automatic acknowledgments are live and replied in three seconds. No further approval is needed for those revisions; their implementation is not yet complete.

Zora is Mindmap’s solutions agent. The full pilot includes W1–W8, S1 commercials and S2 independent QC. The native bridge supports genuine Codex and Claude cloud-session identities without a model API integration. Vercel hosts the portal, automatic email intake, ESC-4 and the five-minute mailbox monitor. Mail collection continues independently; requested AI work must be performed in the active session. All-eight end-to-end acceptance remains unfinished, including ten queued Pentagon checks that have not run.

Pentagon demo and walkthrough delivered, 17 October: the Agent 5 demonstration is deployed at /demos/pentagon under existing pursuit access, with source evidence, exceptions, demo approval and simulated Tally recovery. The two-minute narrated/animated Full HD walkthrough was emailed to Advait with Saurabh/Ganesh copied. These are synthetic demonstrations; live Tally integration and formal W6/W7 acceptance are separate.

requirements.text: It includes the blue-and-white portal identity (with magenta retained for Zora emails), request portal, persistent queue/schema, Microsoft sign-in and isolated email monitoring, native request packs, human gates, private file storage, team access and revision/resume.
Interactive sign-in, actual recurring dispatch and all-eight outputs still need acceptance; a connected database or manually run bridge does not complete the pilot.
